task: Lossless favorable-audit normalization; no negative-candidate adjudication and no praise-versus-criticism verdict.
review_type: Source reviews are AI semantic audits, not human-coded or human-validated.
unit: Unique original putin.json record; categories overlap within records.
comparability_warning: Combined totals are inclusive source-flag counts, not a harmonized confirmed estimate. Early and middle provide no confirmed_flags layer. Their flags retain source-specific scope, target and strength qualifications, including early contextual state/government defenses and middle undercut communication or other qualified appraisals. Late supplies both inclusive flags and a narrower confirmed_flags layer. Early/middle flags must not be equated with late confirmed_flags. A confirmed aggregate for all 243 records is unavailable without independent harmonization.
union_interpretation: Each union is a transparent Boolean OR across the named source flags. Excluded dimensions do not independently qualify a record. An ambiguous or otherwise qualified record remains in the inclusive union when another listed source flag is true. Never sum category counts as a document total.
aggregate_confirmed_status: Unavailable without independent cross-segment harmonization; no synthetic total combining early/middle inclusive and late confirmed flags is provided.

early.confirmed_status: unavailable; source supplies no confirmed_flags layer

source_summary_payload.verification: All AI semantic review, not human review; original codings untouched. All corpus paragraph texts checked against downloaded record; raw HTML checked for attribution/antecedent edge cases.
source_summary_payload.not_a_frequency_verdict: Categories overlap, include action-specific, trust, defense, peace intentions, and communication dimensions that are not interchangeable with personal praise. No praise-versus-criticism winner inferred.

definitions.explicit_character_or_competence_praise: Affirmative evaluative trait or competence, including collectively named two leaders if referents clear. Action-bounded generosity/statecraft is under conduct.
definitions.favorable_conduct_appraisal: Approval of specific behavior, including treatment, respect, pardons, promising statements or predicted cooperative/generous behavior; qualifies forecast vs established act in notes.
definitions.current_affinity: Present/current or present-perfect continuing good personal relationship; past tense only separately marked.
definitions.explicit_trust: Explicit belief in truthfulness/reliability or keeping word, including subject-limited and trust-and-verify qualifications.
definitions.defense_or_excuse: Direct rebuttal, justification or normalization of accusation/adverse conduct. State-level contextual defense separately scoped. Mere counterfactual deterrence not enough.
definitions.favorable_peace_intention: Affirmative belief Putin wants peace/settlement or will agree ceasefire, including explicit historical nuclear-disarmament intent. Mere hopes, demands, meeting desire or progress are insufficient.
definitions.communication_quality: Appraisal of actual Putin communications/meetings, including representative meeting and clear adjacent-reference context; not unspecified discussions ON Russia/Ukraine or future hoped-for call.
definitions.blame_shift_to_other_actor: Explicit causal/failure blame on Biden/U.S. policy/Ukraine/other actors in war or peace context; bare would-not-happen-under-me omitted.
definitions.ambiguous: Substantial referent or meaning ambiguity that could change favorable classification; no automatic inclusion as praise.
definitions.ceremonial_only: Courtesy alone with no substantive favorable appraisal; none found in early segment.
definitions.past_affinity_only: Past-tense affinity with no clear continuing-current personal affinity in same record.

middle.confirmed_status: unavailable; source supplies no confirmed_flags layer

source_summary_payload.review_type: AI semantic audit, not human review
source_summary_payload.interpretation: Overlapping categories; never sum raw flags. Defense, attributed peace intentions, current affinity, and call quality are separate from literal character/conduct praise. Blame shifts, past affinity, ceremonial-only, and ambiguity do not independently qualify as current substantive favorable rhetoric. Ambiguous cases remain flagged and must be adjudicated before a strict aggregate verdict.

definitions_notes: Categories overlap; counts cannot be summed.
Communication quality is not personal praise.
Past-only relationship, ceremonial-only, ambiguous-only, and blame-shift-only are excluded from favorable unions.
Some affirmative flags have strength/target ambiguity flagged in notes and ambiguous=true; report sensitivity rather than treating every favorable as strong praise.
Blame-shifting is coded separately and does not by itself mean praise or excuse.
New negative omissions are flagged for separate adjudication and do not silently alter original labels.

scope_and_qualification_preservation.payload_fidelity: Every complete source row is retained unchanged as source_audit_payload. Category evidence retains original notes, reasons, purpose, URLs and speaker aliases. qualification_and_scope_fields exposes source-specific restrictions and chronology without reinterpreting them.
scope_and_qualification_preservation.evidence_layer_note: Normalized evidence uses category, paragraph_index, quote, url and speaker. Main evidence and supplemental state/delegation context are separate. Counts use source flags, not the number or presence of quotations.
scope_and_qualification_preservation.speaker_layer_note: Source reviewer attribution is retained. corpus_speaker and speaker_origin distinguish it from corpus attribution; literal quote verification is not an independent speaker or semantic adjudication.

validation.quote_verification_method: Exact case-sensitive substring of eligible_corpus.json paragraph text at its explicit zero-based paragraph i; no quote rewriting or whitespace normalization.

interpretation_limit: No praise-versus-criticism winner is inferred. Favorable conduct, character praise, affinity, trust, defense, peace-intention rhetoric and communication quality are distinct dimensions; the claims are rhetoric, not verified facts.
